# Fully functional mini-chess in your server

This plugin adds to your server two new items: chess board and chess tutorial. They can be obtained only by crafting.

![Chess board crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed66963f999cc17216e682340fadf6d2f845526e.png)

![Chess tutorial crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5dd2da134b4708d1ee3316d5ab22f60427448377.png)

A single chess board takes 2 by 2 blocks in your world. To place it just **Right-click** on any horizontal space. To make moves, choose a figure by **Right-click**ing on it and then **Right-click** on decired cell. Any illigal moves are prevented and the corresponding messages will be sent in the chat. The game detects checks, checkmates, stalemates and draws (yes, there are draw in chess, not only stalemate) and visually informs about it any player in 3-block radius to the chess board. To break a chess board **Shift + Left-click** on it.

To open chess tutorial just **Right-click** into the air with the book in your hand.

_**This plugin depends a lot on the resource pack. Without it there won't be any custom textures! So for your convenience install the resource pack as well. Here's a link to [MineChessTextures](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/minechesstextures)**_
